prompt: Two creatures in a deep-emerald old-growth forest clearing, both fully visible side by side, the same size. On the LEFT, a snarling gray-furred wolf is trapped and immobilized, thick gnarled brown tree-roots erupting from the soil and coiling tight around its legs and body, holding it rooted in place as it strains. On the RIGHT, a sturdy green-scaled lizard beast swells larger and stronger, fresh leafy branches and bright new green growth bursting from its back and shoulders, glowing with verdant life. The background is a dense forest of tall trunks and dappled sunlight.

A druid in moss-green robes stands at the center of a forest clearing, arms spread wide casting nature magic in two directions at once. To his LEFT, thick brown roots burst from the ground and ensnare a snarling enemy boar, binding its legs and rooting it helpless to the earth. To his RIGHT, leafy emerald branches and new growth spiral up and around a friendly stag, swelling its body larger and crowning it with antlers of living wood. The only light is the green magical glow from the druid's hands. The background is towering old-growth trees in dappled shade.
